GitHub Copilot CLI: which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on GitHub Copilot CLI

No replay has run on GitHub Copilot CLI. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about GitHub Copilot CLI.

What the GitHub Copilot CLI setup page says about coverage

Copilot decides which tools go through MCP. KYA gates the ones that do. A tool Copilot executes outside MCP is outside the gate. Do not treat this setup as full coverage of the agent.

Source: the GitHub Copilot CLI recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
